title: PermissionResponse
description: Decision sent to a run paused in input_required with the permission_pending cause. The core forwards the chosen option to the child and records the decider.

request_id.description: Identifier of the permission_requested event being answered.

option_id.description: Identifier of the option chosen among those offered by the permission_requested event.

decided_by.description: Who decided: the authority policy or the parent.
